title: AI and the business of law: David Perla on changing law firm economics
summary: As law firms invest more heavily in AI and technology, those investments are reshaping their capital needs, pricing models and the economics of the billable hour. Speaking to SaaSTake, Burford Vice Chair David Perla says, “AI is going to make law firms more capital-intensive at precisely the moment it has the potential to make them more efficient,” as firms consider how to share the benefits of AI-driven efficiency with clients. Learn more.
body_markdown:
As law firms invest more heavily in AI and technology, those investments are reshaping their capital needs, pricing models and the economics of the billable hour. Speaking to SaaSTake, Burford Vice Chair[David Perla](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/david-perla/) says, “AI is going to make law firms more capital-intensive at precisely the moment it has the potential to make them more efficient,” as firms consider how to share the benefits of AI-driven efficiency with clients.


Read the full article[here](https://saastake.com/burford-capital-law-firm-economics/) .
